premises.text: People needing jobs, advice, or opportunities are limited to existing contacts or inadequate bots; they need human conversation with strangers who have the right experience
premises.evidence_span: We need to chat with awesome humans that we don't know

premises.text: Sensei is a messenger contact that uses NLP and match/dispatch to connect users anonymously by default with a relevant human across platforms
premises.evidence_span: Sensei will match you with an awesome human to chat with

premises.text: Conversations are real-time indexed for ML improvement, with ratings and a transactional tipping layer after chats
premises.evidence_span: Sensei's transactional layer kicks in to allow us to tip our Sensei

premises.text: Available across messengers (Slack, FB Messenger, Kik, Telegram, SMS) and expanding globally to LINE, WeChat, and Skype as a conversation marketplace
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is going global, launching in line, WeChat, and Skype in beta

value.text: Easy access to human intelligence and help via chat with the right person at the right time
value.evidence_span: one contact with the experience of millions of people

secondary_value.text: Conversation marketplace where users exchange advice, referrals, opportunities, and jobs
secondary_value.evidence_span: It's a conversation marketplace in which users transact and chat commerce

causal_links.evidence_span: severely limited in our reach via our social graphs
finds and connects you with the perfect person

notes: Contact-list/bot inadequacy folded as one reach problem (§4.1.6). Hire/bully demos as uses of same match mechanism; community response-time/rating stats treated as traction and excluded (§4.1.2/exclusions). 'Future of intelligence is human' kept as value framing not premise (§4.1.4). Singleton D1/D3 retained. Anti-template noted.
